title: webhook-payload.json
description: The body seal-watch POSTs to a site's webhook_url, version 1. This is a contract with somebody else's n8n flow, so the promise is narrow and explicit: fields get added, never repurposed or renamed, the meaning of a value never changes under a consumer, and anything unknown may be ignored. A breaking change raises `version`. The test event exists so that wiring can be proved before an incident, and a consumer that pages a human must ignore it.

version.description: Raised only when a consumer would break. Branch on it.

event.description: alert.test is a delivery check sent on demand and never by a rule. Never treat it as an incident.

status.description: The verdict: fires, watch or ok. Null when the sender had no verdict to report.

headline.description: One line a human can read without opening anything.

started_at.description: When the condition began, not when this was sent. Null when unknown.

evidence.description: Free-form and rule-dependent. Read defensively: no key here is promised.

sent_at.description: ISO 8601, set at delivery. Use it to spot a replay or a stalled queue.
